description: This file defines classes and functions for fetching and processing OECD GDP forecast data, including query parameter handling, data transformation, and API request logic.

classes.name: OECDGdpForecastQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for OECD GDP forecast requests, including country, frequency, and units.

classes.name: OECDGdpForecastData
classes.description: Represents the GDP forecast data retrieved from OECD.

classes.name: OECDGdpForecastFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and processing OECD GDP forecast data, including transforming queries, making API requests, and transforming data.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a validated OECDGdpForecastQueryParams object, handling country list parsing and date defaults.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from OECD API, processes CSV response into structured data, and applies data filtering and formatting.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw API data into a list of OECDGdpForecastData model instances.
